firstContext: 📨 Word came: Rafael Torres wants to join Haven. "I can work. That's all I'm selling." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
